column1: # "???", the Jupiter commander above Heart: Vale's last optional super boss.

column3: ...Who are you?\nYou don't feel like\nanyone I've met.{end_wait}
Does that frighten you?{end_wait}
It makes me careful.\nWhat do you want?{end_wait}
Heart took you for\nsomeone else. You saw\nhow she looked at you.{end_wait}
Matthew. She kept\ncalling me Matthew.{end_wait}

He has been a nuisance
to my commanders.{page_break}Heart cared about
her looks more than
anything else.{page_break}Matthew ruined her face.
She can't bear to look
at her reflection now.{page_break}She saw him in you.
I knew she would.{end_wait}
That wasn't me.{end_wait}
I know. He wears\nyour face. Amusing,\nisn't it.{end_wait}
Where would you have\nmet someone who looks\nlike me?{end_wait}
Not yet, Isaac.\nNot for a long while.\nThat is the point.{end_wait}

I wanted to see the
original. I'm curious,
that's all.{page_break}Ash Jenna fears being
alone. Sarah is looking
for someone she lost.{page_break}Kegare took Mia's face.
She wanted what Mia has:
people who care for her.{page_break}They all found you,
didn't they?{end_wait}

A word at the right
time can change a path.
They chose their own.{page_break}I'll hold back in
our fight. Consider
it a courtesy.{page_break}I don't want to break
you before I know
what you are.{end_wait}
...You're\nunderestimating me.{end_wait}

Perhaps.
Draw your sword.{page_break}Your friends are bound.
They won't interfere.{page_break}They're unharmed.
This is between us,
Isaac.{end_wait}
Tell me who you are.{end_wait}

You've asked three
times now. That's
three more than most.{page_break}Your friends are free.
I kept my word.{end_wait}
This was only a test,\nIsaac. You passed it.{page_break}Be glad you did not\nneed the rest of me.{end_wait}
A test of what?{end_wait}
Of whether you are\nworth the trouble.{end_wait}

Heart overstepped when
she came for you.{page_break}I will remind her
whose orders she
carries.{end_wait}
Your orders?{end_wait}
Even a lens needs\nsomeone to point it.{end_wait}
When the Grave Eclipse\ncomes, remember\nthis day.{end_wait}
Thirty years, Isaac.\nI will see you then.{end_wait}
Isaac! I can't move!\nWhat did you do to us?{end_wait}
My Psynergy won't answer.\nShe's holding it back.{end_wait}
She's been waiting for us.\nIsaac, don't believe this\nwas a chance meeting.{end_wait}
Let them go.\nI'm the one you want.{end_wait}
I have what I want.\nShow me what you can do.{end_wait}
Thirty years?\nWhat did she mean by that?{end_wait}
